subject.title: feat(ios): replace the tab bar with a black overlay sidebar (web parity + dashboard)

question: Should OpenClaw replace the existing iPhone tab bar and Control hub for all users with the sidebar-first root-navigation model in this PR?
rationale: This is a broad, intentional change to a shipped primary navigation workflow; the branch states that it is maintainer-directed, but the protected maintainer label requires an explicit human confirmation of the permanent product direction.

options.title: Confirm sidebar-first navigation
options.body: Approve the tab-bar retirement as the intended iPhone navigation model, contingent on fixing the Android localization regression before merge.

options.title: Retain the current phone navigation
options.body: Keep the tab bar and Control hub, and extract only independently valuable sidebar/session improvements behind the existing navigation structure.

recommendation.title: Confirm sidebar-first navigation
recommendation.body: Approve the tab-bar retirement as the intended iPhone navigation model, contingent on fixing the Android localization regression before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR and the related Overview-retirement direction connect this person most directly to the proposed navigation model.
